newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-DODGERS' GUERRERO SUSPENDED FOR USING ILLEGAL BAT.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-DODGERS' GUERRERO SUSPENDED FOR USING ILLEGAL BAT.

text.p: Los Angeles Dodgers second baseman Wilton Guerrero was suspended for eight games by the National League on Monday for using a corked bat in Sunday's 6-1 victory over the St Louis Cardinals.
Guerrero, a rookie, was also fined an undisclosed amount by NL President Leonard Coleman.
On the third pitch of the game, Guerrero broke his bat in half while grounding out to second, exposing the cork.
Home plate umpire Steve Rippley took to broken bat to crew chief Bruce Froemming, who inspected it and promptly ejected Guerrero from the game for using a doctored bat.
"I apologise to the National League and my teammates," Guerrero said through an interpreter on Sunday.
"This will not happen again. It is the first time I used the bat. I never used it before (but) I knew it was corked. I've had the bat for two or three months."
The 22-year-old Guerrero is hitting .290 with a homer, 13 RBI and five stolen bases in 50 games.
He will be eligible to return to the Dodgers lineup on June 10.
